items.title: DataOrbit launches Monday August 31, 2026
items.body:
DataOrbit is the DynamoDB GUI the AWS console never was.

## What's included

- **Browse** — grid + JSON views, row detail panel, schema inspector
- **Explore** — query builder with GSI support, filter expressions, cost warnings
- **Live Streams** — real-time DynamoDB Streams event viewer
- **Cross-table joins** — inner, left, left-anti, right, right-anti
- **Query history** — full history with search
- **CouchDB** support
- **No Electron, no JVM** — pure Rust + Tauri

Free forever. MIT licensed.

items.title: Speed up queries — always use a GSI
items.body:
Scanning large DynamoDB tables is slow and expensive. In DataOrbit's Explore tab, open the **Index** dropdown to pick a GSI — filter fields update automatically to match the index keys.

Always prefer a GSI query over a Scan when you know the access pattern.
